about: Fields the product compares with the clock, for the #1696 scan (scripts/scan-fixed-dates-1696.mjs --fields). A fixed date that reaches one of these fields in a test that also reaches a real server or process is flagged. Fields NOT on this list are uncovered, not safe. Each entry cites the line that compares it with the clock; a test checks that the line still names the field beside a clock expression, which does not verify what the comparison means.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.why: A credential whose expiresAt is at or before now is refused as expired, and one inside the expiry window is reported as expiring.

fields.name: parkedUntil
fields.why: A card is parked, and left out of the ready queue, while parkedUntil is later than now.

fields.name: claimedAt
fields.why: A claim older than the stale limit (hours since claimedAt) is flagged stale; core/in-flight.mjs:65 windows the same field.

fields.name: quietUntil
fields.why: A stale claim whose holder said when they would be back is skipped while now is before quietUntil.
